fee.desc: a mushroom fairy girl with turquoise hair, a small golden crown, translucent purple butterfly wings, a pink dress with a lilac belt and a mushroom buckle, purple leggings, holding a wooden staff topped with a red spotted mushroom

humus.desc: Humus the bearded mushroom forager, a friendly man with a brown beard, a green felt hat with a leaf and a small mushroom, a cream shirt with a brown neckerchief, brown shorts and belt, green socks, brown boots, a big green bedroll backpack, holding a tall gnarled wooden walking staff

odile.desc: Odile the young mushroom forager girl with long brown hair, a green felt bucket hat with a leaf, a green neckerchief, a cream shirt with brown suspenders, brown shorts, green socks, brown boots, a green bedroll backpack, holding a tall wooden walking staff with a leaf

vesce.desc: Vesce the old mushroom forager woman with long white hair, a purple wide-brimmed hat with a red band and a feather, a lilac neckerchief, a white shirt with dark purple suspenders, purple shorts, purple boots, a purple bedroll backpack, holding a tall wooden walking staff
